set.title: Implement Beskar per docs/BRIEF.md in Rust with zero dependencies
set.body: Deliver the CLI described in docs/BRIEF.md as a Rust workspace with no external crates: a line-oriented config format (Slate) with its own parser, SHA-256 fingerprints, library/profile/registry domain model, drift-aware reconciliation, and the full command tree (init, doctor, library, profile, repo, registry).

text: Implemented as a three-crate workspace (slate, beskar-core, beskar) with zero external dependencies. Slate is a line-oriented config format (see docs/slate.md). 33 tests including end-to-end CLI tests in an isolated BESKAR_HOME.

reason: Beskar implemented per brief: Slate format, library/profile/registry, drift-aware reconciliation, full command tree
